SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-15-2020 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO FEB-14-2020 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506. IF NO APPEARANCES, CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. MATTER IS HEARD IN CONJUNCTION WITH THREE RELATED CASES ON THE 8:30 AM CALENDAR. PLAINTIFF SERGIO A. JUAREZ IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT METROPOLITAN LIFE INSURANCE REPRESENTED ROBERT BENNET, AGENT FOR METROPOLITAN LIFE IS PRESENT. METROPOLITAN LIFE AND SERGIO JUAREZ AGREE TO COMPLETE SETTLEMENT OF ALL CLAIMS IN CSM-19-861454 ON THE FOLLOWING TERMS: METROPOLITAN LIFE SHALL PAY $6441.49 TO PLAINTIFF, SERGIO JUAREZ. IN RETURN SERGIO JUAREZ WILL RELEASE METROPOLITAN LIFE FOR ALL CLAIMS, BOTH KNOWN AND UNKNOWN. ADDITIONALLY, THE FOLLOWING CASES ARE TO BE DISMISSED BY SERGIO JUAREZ AS A RESULT OF THIS SETTLEMENT: SERGIO JUAREZ VS. ERNESTO HERNANDEZ, CSM-19-861452; SERGIO JUAREZ VS. KEYANNA CARTER, CSM-19-861451; SERGIO JUAREZ VS. SHINE-N-SEAL CAR WASH CSM-19-861453. METROPOLITAN LIFE IS TO SEND SERGIO JUAREZ RELEASE DOCUMENTS BY FRIDAY, JANUARY 17, 2020. MR. JUAREZ IS TO RETURN THE SIGNED DOCUMENTS WITHIN FIVE DAYS OF RECEIPT. METROPOLITAN LIFE IS TO THEN SEND MR. JUAREZ A CHECK FOR $6441.49 WITHIN FIVE DAYS OF RECEIVING SIGNED RELEASE DOCUMENTS. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
ORDER RE: CONTINUANCE FOR PROGRESS REPORT RE: SETTLEMENT. PROGRESS REPORT SET FOR FEBRUARY 14, 2020 AT 8:30 A.M. IF NO APPEARNCE, CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED.
